tools.name: bootstrap_learner
tools.description: Create the caller profile and default preferences exactly once
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO learner_profiles (id,user_id,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :__uuid,:__user_id,:__now,:__now WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learner_profiles WHERE user_id=:__user_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO learner_preferences (id,user_id,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :__uuid,:__user_id,:__now,:__now WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learner_preferences WHERE user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learner_profiles WHERE user_id=:__user_id)

tools.name: get_learner_bootstrap
tools.description: Read the caller profile, preferences and active lesson
tools.sql: SELECT p.id AS profile_id,p.display_name,p.created_at AS profile_created_at, q.id AS preference_id,q.source_language,q.target_language,q.region,q.timezone,q.reminders_enabled, s.id AS session_id,s.course_version_id,s.lesson_id,s.status AS session_status,s.last_exercise_position FROM learner_profiles p LEFT JOIN learner_preferences q ON q.user_id=p.user_id LEFT JOIN learning_sessions s ON s.id=(SELECT id FROM learning_sessions WHERE user_id=:__user_id AND status='active' ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE p.user_id=:__user_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: get_next_lesson
tools.description: Return the oldest uncompleted lesson in an active published course release
tools.sql: SELECT l.id AS lesson_id,l.course_version_id,l.content_version,l.position,l.title, c.id AS course_id,c.source_language,c.target_language,r.release_number FROM course_releases r JOIN course_versions v ON v.id=r.course_version_id AND v.course_id=r.course_id JOIN courses c ON c.id=r.course_id JOIN lessons l ON l.course_version_id=v.id WHERE r.status='active' AND v.status='published' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learner_profiles p WHERE p.user_id=:__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_sessions done WHERE done.user_id=:__user_id AND done.lesson_id=l.id AND done.status='completed') ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id,l.position,l.id LIMIT 1

tools.name: start_lesson
tools.description: Start a released lesson once; concurrent starts cannot create duplicate active sessions
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO learning_sessions (id,user_id,course_version_id,lesson_id,status,last_exercise_position,started_at,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :__uuid,:__user_id,l.course_version_id,l.id,'active',0,:__now,:__now,:__now FROM lessons l JOIN course_versions v ON v.id=l.course_version_id JOIN course_releases r ON r.course_version_id=v.id AND r.course_id=v.course_id WHERE l.id=:lesson_id AND r.status='active' AND v.status='published' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learner_profiles p WHERE p.user_id=:__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_sessions s WHERE s.user_id=:__user_id AND s.lesson_id=l.id AND s.status IN ('active','completed')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lessons earlier WHERE earlier.course_version_id=l.course_version_id AND earlier.position<l.position AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_sessions done WHERE done.user_id=:__user_id AND done.lesson_id=earlier.id AND done.status='completed'))

tools.name: resume_lesson
tools.description: Read an owned active lesson snapshot and checkpoint
tools.sql: SELECT s.id,s.course_version_id,s.lesson_id,s.last_exercise_position,s.started_at,s.updated_at, l.title,l.content_version,v.package_version FROM learning_sessions s JOIN lessons l ON l.id=s.lesson_id JOIN course_versions v ON v.id=s.course_version_id WHERE s.id=:session_id AND s.user_id=:__user_id AND s.status='active' LIMIT 1

tools.name: submit_exercise
tools.description: Record an ungraded exercise attempt and advance its owned session checkpoint atomically
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO exercise_attempts (id,user_id,session_id,lesson_id,exercise_id,attempt_number,evaluator_policy_version,result_code,created_at) SELECT :attempt_id,:__user_id,s.id,s.lesson_id,e.id, (SELECT COUNT(*)+1 FROM exercise_attempts a WHERE a.user_id=:__user_id AND a.session_id=s.id AND a.exercise_id=e.id), e.evaluator_policy_version,'pending_evaluation',:__now FROM learning_sessions s JOIN exercises e ON e.lesson_id=s.lesson_id WHERE s.id=:session_id AND s.user_id=:__user_id AND s.status='active' AND s.updated_at=:expected_updated_at AND :__now>:expected_updated_at AND e.id=:exercise_id AND e.position=s.last_exercise_position AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exercise_attempts a WHERE a.id=:attempt_id) AND lower(:attempt_id) GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'

UPDATE learning_sessions SET last_exercise_position=last_exercise_position+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:session_id AND user_id=:__user_id AND status='active' AND updated_at=:expected_updated_at AND :__now>:expected_updated_at AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exercise_attempts a WHERE a.id=:attempt_id AND a.user_id=:__user_id AND a.session_id=:session_id AND a.exercise_id=:exercise_id AND a.created_at=:__now) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exercises e WHERE e.id=:exercise_id AND e.lesson_id=learning_sessions.lesson_id AND e.position=learning_sessions.last_exercise_position)

attempt_id.description: Stable UUID idempotency key for this attempt

tools.name: complete_lesson
tools.description: Complete an owned session after every exercise has an attempt
tools.sql: UPDATE learning_sessions SET status='completed',completed_at=:__now,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:session_id AND user_id=:__user_id AND status='active' AND updated_at=:expected_updated_at AND :__now>:expected_updated_at AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exercises e WHERE e.lesson_id=learning_sessions.lesson_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exercises e WHERE e.lesson_id=learning_sessions.lesson_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exercise_attempts a WHERE a.user_id=:__user_id AND a.session_id=learning_sessions.id AND a.exercise_id=e.id))

tools.name: list_due_reviews
tools.description: List caller review states due now with a bounded keyset cursor
tools.sql: SELECT rs.id,rs.course_id,rs.stable_content_id,rs.source_exercise_id,rs.due_at,rs.interval_days,rs.review_count,rs.updated_at FROM review_states rs WHERE rs.user_id=:__user_id AND rs.due_at<=:__now AND (:before_due_at IS NULL OR (rs.due_at,rs.id)>(:before_due_at,:before_id)) ORDER BY rs.due_at,rs.id LIMIT :limit

tools.name: record_review
tools.description: Record a due review exposure only after an owned attempt on its source exercise
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO learning_exposures (id,user_id,session_id,lesson_id,exercise_id,exposure_kind,created_at) SELECT :exposure_id,:__user_id,s.id,s.lesson_id,rs.source_exercise_id,'review',:__now FROM review_states rs JOIN exercises e ON e.id=rs.source_exercise_id JOIN learning_sessions s ON s.lesson_id=e.lesson_id AND s.user_id=:__user_id WHERE rs.id=:review_id AND rs.user_id=:__user_id AND rs.due_at<=:__now AND s.id=:session_id AND s.status IN ('active','completed') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exercise_attempts a WHERE a.user_id=:__user_id AND a.session_id=s.id AND a.exercise_id=e.id AND a.created_at>=rs.due_at) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_exposures x WHERE x.id=:exposure_id) AND lower(:exposure_id) GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'

tools.name: update_preferences

tools.sql: UPDATE learner_preferences SET source_language=:source_language,target_language=:target_language, region=:region,timezone=:timezone,reminders_enabled=:reminders_enabled,updated_at=:__now WHERE user_id=:__user_id AND updated_at=:expected_updated_at AND :__now>:expected_updated_at AND :reminders_enabled IN (0,1)

tools.name: create_content_report
tools.description: Report an exercise from an owned session without sending answer text
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO content_reports (id,user_id,exercise_id,category,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :report_id,:__user_id,e.id,:category,'open',:__now,:__now FROM learning_sessions s JOIN exercises e ON e.lesson_id=s.lesson_id WHERE s.id=:session_id AND s.user_id=:__user_id AND e.id=:exercise_id AND :category IN ('answer','wording','audio','translation','explanation','accessibility','other') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_reports r WHERE r.id=:report_id) AND lower(:report_id) GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'

tools.name: list_content_reports
tools.description: List caller reports with bounded keyset pagination
tools.sql: SELECT id,exercise_id,category,status,created_at,updated_at FROM content_reports WHERE user_id=:__user_id AND (:before_created_at IS NULL OR (created_at,id)<(:before_created_at,:before_id)) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: read_objective_graph
tools.description: Read a version-pinned objective graph in deterministic keyset order
tools.sql: SELECT o.id,o.course_version_id,o.lesson_id,o.label,o.description,o.locale,o.sort_order,(SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(json_object('id',x.id,'rel_type',x.rel_type,'sort_order',x.sort_order,'locale',x.locale,'form',x.form,'lemma',x.lemma,'part_of_speech',x.part_of_speech)),'[]') FROM (SELECT c.*, e.rel_type, e.sort_order FROM objective_lexeme e JOIN lexeme c ON c.id=e.lexeme_id AND c.course_version_id=e.course_version_id WHERE e.objective_id=o.id AND e.course_version_id=o.course_version_id ORDER BY e.sort_order,e.id) x) AS lexemes_json,(SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(json_object('id',x.id,'rel_type',x.rel_type,'sort_order',x.sort_order,'locale',x.locale,'text',x.text)),'[]') FROM (SELECT c.*, e.rel_type, e.sort_order FROM objective_phrase e JOIN phrase c ON c.id=e.phrase_id AND c.course_version_id=e.course_version_id WHERE e.objective_id=o.id AND e.course_version_id=o.course_version_id ORDER BY e.sort_order,e.id) x) AS phrases_json,(SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(json_object('id',x.id,'rel_type',x.rel_type,'sort_order',x.sort_order,'locale',x.locale,'label',x.label,'description',x.description)),'[]') FROM (SELECT c.*, e.rel_type, e.sort_order FROM objective_grammar e JOIN grammar_point c ON c.id=e.grammar_point_id AND c.course_version_id=e.course_version_id WHERE e.objective_id=o.id AND e.course_version_id=o.course_version_id ORDER BY e.sort_order,e.id) x) AS grammar_points_json,(SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(json_object('id',x.id,'rel_type',x.rel_type,'sort_order',x.sort_order,'locale',x.locale,'pattern',x.pattern,'example',x.example)),'[]') FROM (SELECT c.*, e.rel_type, e.sort_order FROM objective_pronunciation e JOIN pronunciation_pattern c ON c.id=e.pronunciation_pattern_id AND c.course_version_id=e.course_version_id WHERE e.objective_id=o.id AND e.course_version_id=o.course_version_id ORDER BY e.sort_order,e.id) x) AS pronunciation_patterns_json,(SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(json_object('id',x.id,'rel_type',x.rel_type,'sort_order',x.sort_order,'locale',x.locale,'name',x.name,'description',x.description)),'[]') FROM (SELECT c.*, e.rel_type, e.sort_order FROM objective_register e JOIN register_tag c ON c.id=e.register_tag_id AND c.course_version_id=e.course_version_id WHERE e.objective_id=o.id AND e.course_version_id=o.course_version_id ORDER BY e.sort_order,e.id) x) AS register_tags_json,(SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(json_object('id',x.id,'rel_type',x.rel_type,'sort_order',x.sort_order,'locale',x.locale,'item_a',x.item_a,'item_b',x.item_b,'note',x.note)),'[]') FROM (SELECT c.*, e.rel_type, e.sort_order FROM objective_confusable e JOIN confusable_pair c ON c.id=e.confusable_pair_id AND c.course_version_id=e.course_version_id WHERE e.objective_id=o.id AND e.course_version_id=o.course_version_id ORDER BY e.sort_order,e.id) x) AS confusable_pairs_json,(SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(json_object('id',x.id,'sort_order',x.sort_order)),'[]') FROM (SELECT p.prerequisite_objective_id AS id,p.sort_order FROM objective_prerequisite p WHERE p.objective_id=o.id AND p.course_version_id=o.course_version_id ORDER BY p.sort_order,p.id) x) AS prerequisites_json FROM objective o WHERE o.course_version_id=:version_id AND (:after_sort_order IS NULL OR (o.sort_order,o.id)>(:after_sort_order,:after_id)) ORDER BY o.sort_order,o.id LIMIT MIN(MAX(:limit,1),100)
